Both elliptic norms on the accepted C2 model now use the existing direct base-field formulas. The old C0/C1 constructor keeps its whitelist; a separate explicit C2 factory supplies[19,10,22]. Original generic C2 coordinates remain, generic Phi2/quarter-Psi2 use genuine divisor norms, and naive halving keeps generic Phi2. The maps and DLP transport are unchanged. SUCCESSOR_NORMS.md/PCC7fb16a (upstream95693e) gives the exact Picard specialization and all repeated/zero/infinity cases; seven upstream conditional Lean identitiesc2aaaa retain explicit written geometric bridges. [pcc:unverified]

Complete changed check.sh04 passes25 native/81 reference unit plus five integrations, one pre-existing ignored benchmark, all source guards/formatting/strictClippy. Both norms agree on all12317 rational classes, every degree/zero category,118 repeated supports and238 infinity corrections. Every forward/dual Phi2 and Psi2 input agrees with its retained generic reference; all prior/source109/113/naive/closed/pointwise/geometric controls pass. PCC03b76b pins exact three final source04 snapshots/hashes and complete96421-byte raw receipt,standard-xz11612bytes with raw/archive SHA256 and exact roundtrip. PCC0355ab/d14c30/158476 preserve targeted receipts;238524 pins the inspected two-page report/DOT/SVG/Typst. Scientific standing remains unsigned, formalization partial, and no stage/pipeline/ECDLP cost advantage is measured. [pcc:unverified]

Depends on #1494 and targets its immediate feature branch research/chained-transfer-successor-seven-20261111 at43a8e80ea4d01c564499e678751f44c51dae5243. This head is65aabe34879630ad4d973021fb21307e1d856dc1. Parent1494 exact-head focusedCI43125719626 succeeds25/80+five,gate passes/sign skips; full decoded logs/API/check metadata d942e6 are archived here. This child's own exact-head CI and review remain separate obligations. Feature-base auto-merge is unavailable; integrate bottom-up, then retarget main and rerun actual requirements. Frozen-ledger forks and parent1484 unchanged-C failures are preserved. [pcc:unverified]

SUCCESSOR_NORMS_STATUS.md, upstream PR3877 and queue3904 retain the resume state. Next CT26 tests deferred construction and canonical selection of the pointwise evaluator's quadratic root table against the old exhaustive builder. The proposed lower-degree rewrite was a recorded no-op because those formulas are already algebraic. Matched cold index-calculus/rho comparisons remain owed under admitted protocols; S3/currentlivebudget, locked atlas and ledger integration remain blocked. No benchmark,solver,paid allocation,checkpoint bypass or history rewrite. [pcc:unverified]
